name: The True Masters
summary: Marshal Maxwell asks you to find Ragged John, who can speak of Marshal Windsor’s fate. What you learn will help Maxwell understand what became of Windsor.

sections.title: A Search to the North
sections.body: Marshal Maxwell points you toward a cave to the north, where he believes Ragged John can be found. You are to ask John about Marshal Windsor’s fate, then return to Maxwell with what you learn.

faq.q: Who is asking me to find Ragged John?
faq.answer: Marshal Maxwell asks you to seek Ragged John and learn of Marshal Windsor’s fate.

faq.q: Where should I look for Ragged John?
faq.answer: Marshal Maxwell recalls directing you to search for Ragged John in a cave to the north.

faq.q: What does Maxwell want to know?
faq.answer: Maxwell wants you to learn of Marshal Windsor’s fate from Ragged John.

faq.q: What do I do after speaking with Ragged John?
faq.answer: Return to Marshal Maxwell after you have learned what Ragged John can tell you about Windsor.

attribution: In-game quest text: The True Masters
